description: Anonymous non-affiliate Korean storefront direct HTTP client with source-backed search, product/detail, options and review reads. The client is implemented and 12 focused tests pass; browser XHRs returned JSON 200, while direct Node/Python/curl calls currently receive Cloudflare 403 HTML. Account login is not established as the remedy.

capabilities.title: Independent direct-HTTP search and KRW price mapping
capabilities.blocker: Client and focused local tests exist; anonymous browser XHRs returned JSON 200 and first-party request builders are source mapped. Independent HTTP is still blocked: Node requests to search/detail/extra returned 403 HTML even with captured browser UA, observed headers and anonymous cookies; Python requests returned 403 both cookie-free and with current CF cookies plus actual UA; native curl returned cookie-free 403 over HTTP/2. The cookie-enabled curl retry status is unknown because its metadata parser failed. This does not establish an account-login requirement. See the transport receipt.
capabilities.note: Client code and 12 focused local tests are present. The required live gate remains blocked until direct HTTP replay succeeds; optional cookies accept only Cloudflare challenge names and the client has no browser fallback.
